captions.detailed: A compact orange and black Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope mounted on a single-arm equatorial fork mount. The stubby cylindrical optical tube assembly features a black rear cell with an eyepiece and a black corrector ring at the front. The tube is pivoted on a horizontal declination axis at the tip of an L-shaped orange fork arm, which rotates on a right ascension axis. The entire fork structure is supported by an orange polar wedge, which tilts the mount assembly on top of a three-legged grey tripod with black feet.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact Schmidt-Cassegrain telescope model on a single-arm equatorial fork mount. The telescope should feature a rotating right ascension axis on an angled polar wedge, a pivoting declination axis on the single fork arm, and a stable three-legged tripod base.
captions.factory: Construct the tripod base using cylinders for the central pier and angled cylinders for the three legs, capped with rectangular boxes for feet. Model the wedge assembly using a tilted rectangular plate and supporting brackets. Create the L-shaped fork arm by combining rectangular prisms and a cylindrical pivot joint, and construct the telescope tube using concentric cylinders for the main body, corrector plate, and eyepiece.
